newsitem.title: UK: MRS Logistica plans $320 million 2-tranche bond.
newsitem.headline: MRS Logistica plans $320 million 2-tranche bond.

text.p: The MRS Logistica consortium, led by Brazilian steel firm CSN, is expected to launch a two-tranche bond for $320 million in August, bankers said on Friday.
Roadshows for the deal are expected to start next week. Bankers Trust was tipped as lead manager, but officials there declined to comment on the deal.
Bankers elsewhere said both tranches were expected to have eight-year maturities but with different put and call structures.
A $150 million tranche would have puts and calls after three years, and a $170 million tranche would just have a call option after four years.
Last September, the consortium acquired a 30-year concession to operate the southeast section of Brazil's federal railway network.
MRS Logistica also includes steel firm Cosigua, mining companies MBR and Ferteco, fertilizer firm Ultrafertil, transport groups Celato and Interferrea and two pension funds.
